translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Faha ana tofaisewa adi gahetalahobuhobu.
KaduꞋe Yesu gigahe gigayo, “Yaubada yana yoꞋogaga ana luku hidede amine. Tonifaha lakahina gimiyami tu mala gilauna gihobu be gina yana faha ana tofaisewa ginaleledi.
Kaliva tufoidi ginuhagadi-yo adi laufata buye hilukahihiyena higa vaita aiyeta saꞋeyana fatana ginaveledi, ada au yana faha againe giꞋiveninisedi.
Gimiyami tu kauwana gilaka au gina kaliva velugadiyao melaleya himiyamiya-kawowo ma giꞋitadi.
Gigahedi gigayo, Kadu omiꞋiyao ma wanana yaku faheya wanafaisewa be fata hagihagina ganavelemi.
Au badi hina tu kauwana getadeya kadu kauwana giwahivekenana amine gina kaliva givaidi.
Ada mala gilavina amine kadu gihobu kaliva tufoidi melaleya himiyamiya-kawowo giꞋitadi-yo gigahedi gigayo, Gavadi-yo wamiyamiya-kawowo tu mala a gilavina?
Badi higayo, Keke tamo hakwadi faisewa gidavelema. Bana gigayo, Au kadu omi wanana yaku faheya wanafaisewa.

Badi hina tu mala a gibogi-yo tonifaha yana tofaisewa adi toꞋitaveꞋavina gigahena gigayo, Tofaisewa unayowanidi be adi laufata unaveledi. Badi wai himulina-ma unamidiveledi unanunauwena tu badi wai hinagona-ma muliya unaveledi.
Au badi wai himulina-ma hiꞋela be aiyeta saꞋeyana fatana aiyeta saꞋeyana fatana hivaina.
Atu badi wai hinagona-ma hiꞋela be yadi mani hinavaina againe, hinuwanuwa vaita adi laufata ginaꞋalalaka tu kadu badi aiyeta saꞋeyana fatana hivaina.

Yadi mani hivaini-yo hivebutu tonifaha againe hiꞋalawoluwolu higayo, Hida hima kaliva wai himulina-ma bai saꞋeyanaga hifaisewa tu imeꞋeyao ma malalaugeya avebutu anunauwena kauwana lakahina gikabuma tu ama laufata badi adi laufata amine.
Tonifaha tofaisewa saꞋeyana gigahena gigayo, Tobohiyaku, unogali. Keke o againiya gadakivekoyo. A laufata buye kalukahihiyena tu kagahe vaita aiyeta saꞋeyana fatana ganavele.
Au ya mani uvaini be una. Iya nuwanuwaku kaliva wai gimulina-ma aiyeta saꞋeyana fatana ya mani amine ganavelena.
Yaku mani gavadi gavadi againe ganaseni-ma iya tauku akufaiweya ganavehimeyena. Gavadi-yo iya gafolafolaka faꞋina o ugaꞋumaꞋuma?”
Hidedemi Yesu gigahetalahobuhobu kadu yana gahe giluyabuna gigayo, “Au badi wai hinagona-ma wai hinamulina tu badi wai himulina-ma wai hinanagona.”
Tova anaveto Yesu yana alika faꞋina gilukahihi.

Tu Yesu Yelusalema againe ginauna tu ana tomuliya tuwelo gisiꞋaliyedi gigahedi gigayo, “WaꞋita, Yelusalema againe kananauna ada Iya TohobuꞋela abaveyao ana tofaisewa kikaiwabudiyao kadu Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala nimadiya hinahegenauweku, be badi alikeya hinahegeku.

Nuwanuwadi alikeya hinahegeku faꞋina yoꞋo tulidiyao nimadiya hinahegenauweku be badi hinahawavelaigeku kadu hinamunukoyokoyoku ada kelose againe hinatutuvefoseku. Atu tova anaveto againe Yaubada alikeya ginasivemididiku.” Hidedemi Yesu givenuwaꞋatadi.
Yemesa Yoni hinadi hiveꞋoꞋola be natudiyao hinakaiwabu.
Tu medema tovai-nadi Sebedi vavinena wanatudiyao Yesu againe hiꞋela hiꞋiboꞋula-moꞋa be higa tamo gavadi faꞋina hinaveꞋoꞋola.
Bana gigayo, “Gavadi-yo waꞋela?” Badi higayo, “Udavehimeya be tova mulina unakaiwabu-moꞋa againe, hida natukweyao adiꞋiselu buye wadakaiwabu higa iꞋataginiya kadu iꞋimawaniya hidavetoga.”

Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “Gavadi waveꞋoꞋolena-ma ana nuwanuwa keke wadahalamaneni. Aimo tagiya aulolo ana gowa ganayuyena. Iya ganayuyena amine, kaꞋi kadu omi amiꞋiselu amifaiweya wanayuyena o kaꞋi keke?” Badi higayo, “Ime amafaiweya anayuyena.”

Yesu gigayo, “Wona velemona yaku tagiya yaku aulolo ana gowa againe wanayu tu gaveyao iꞋatagikuya iꞋimawakuya hinavetoga, medema keke yaku abavehimeya. Au gaveyao faꞋidiya Kamaku mena abavetoga kikaiwabuna gikidewedewena, medema hinavaina.”
Tu tomuliya velugadiyao teni Sebedi natuneyao adiꞋiselu yadi veꞋoꞋola hinogalina againe hinuwakoyoyedi.

Au Yesu gikovavagaꞋauhidi gigahedi gigayo, “Omi wahalamanena yoꞋo tulidiyao yadi tovehimeya yadi waꞋagodadaga hiꞋitaꞋitaveꞋavidi, kadu yadi tokaiwabu yadi waselakalaka kaliva koyokoyodiyao higahegahedi.
Tu omiꞋiyao ma keke medede amine wanahuluhuluva. Au gaveyao omi agaimiya nuwanuwami wanakikaiwabu, medema tobohiyamiyao agaidiya wanavetofaisewa.
Kadu gaveyao nuwanuwami wanavetonagona, medema tobohiyamiyao agaidiya wanaveꞋagetoga.

Meda anafaiweya Iya TohobuꞋela keke omi tomiyababi agaimiya gadaꞋela be omi wanavelugaku faꞋina. Au gaꞋela be Iya omi ganavelugami ada yawaiku ganahawahegena be mena yaku laufata againe moyaꞋaimi yami koyona faꞋina yogoyogonimiyao wamimiyami-ma ganayaumi.” Hidedemi Yesu gigahe.
Tomatakoyo adiꞋiselu hiyamumu.
Tu Yesu ana tomuliya buye melala ana egana Yeliko hilowolowoga tu yoꞋo lakahidi hivebwaꞋuliyena.
Tomatakoyo adiꞋiselu edeya hihiyoto tu Yesu lilidiya ginauna ma hinogalini-yo hivebutu hikovakova higayo, “Kauveya, O Devida bwanenena, udaꞋitanuwakabubuyema.”
Kaliva yoꞋoyoꞋo agaidiya hidakeyedi be higa hinaveꞋamata. Tu badi kadu agodi gilakata-moꞋa hikovadona higayo, “Kauveya, O Devida bwanenena, udaꞋitanuwakabubuyema.”
Au Yesu ginumidi ada giyowanidi be hiꞋela ada gigayo, “Gavadi nuwanuwami omi faꞋimiya ganagani?”
Badi higayo, “Kauveya, matama gidaꞋitalele.”
Au Yesu gihinekalikaliyedi matadi gikibwaꞋena ada auheꞋama matadi giꞋitaꞋitalele ada Yesu himuliyena.
